{{Otheruses|Ministry of Supply}}
The '''Ministry of Supply''' was part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Civil Government]]. The Ministry was in charge of begging, borrowing, or stealing essential supplies such as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and clothing to keep the Alliance military forces in fighting shape.

While the Alliance grew an abundance of food on [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]] and [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], transporting it was another matter. The Ministry of Supply relied on the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] assigned to the [[Support Services/Legends|Support Services]].
